name: I-on Moon
source:
"When I'm with you, even small talk feels precious. It's strange, Little Miss."

Once the most famous genius.

I-on, struggling under the 'burden of a genius' imposed by the media after his grandmother's passing, and the protagonist, who lost her everyday life after being unable to do what she loved, meet in the library and gradually grow close through reading competitions. The time they spent together in the library became a great comfort to both of them. However... as we were reclaiming our daily lives from hurt and heartbreak, why did this "incident" happen to us?
